in_sanskrit.name: Sadeep
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Deep, Wise
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Sadeep एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Sadeep is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sad' which means 'deep' and 'Deep' meaning 'wisdom'. This name is for a baby boy born near a deep body of water, symbolizing the depth of knowledge and wisdom that the baby is expected to acquire in life.
